title: On Enabling the boys to finish school
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：enable　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 enable 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the director ① enabled the boys to finish school on the same day, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② enables the boys to finish school before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ enable the boys to finish school at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ enabled the boys to finish school before — a line in the poster for August 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Enabling the boys to finish school on the same day, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ enable the village to pay its debts before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Enable the village to pay its debts at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ enables the village to pay its debts on the same day every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ enabled the boys to finish school again when nobody else would.

⑩ To enable the boys to finish school, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody enables the boys to finish school before dawn again and somebody must enable the boys to finish school on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使能够（一般过去式 enabled the boys to finish school：1989 年导演头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 使能够（一般现在 enables the boys to finish school：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使能够（不定式 to enable the boys to finish school：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使能够（过去完成时 had enabled the boys to finish school：1983 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 使能够（动名词 enabling the boys to finish school 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使成为（enable the village to pay its debts：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使成为使村子还得上欠账）
G. v. 使成为（enable the village to pay its debts：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使能够（后段两处：新来的演员照例 enables the village to pay its debts，而母亲又一次 enabled the boys to finish school）

answers.why: enable 意为“使能够”，1989 年导演当天就使能够让那些孩子把书念完，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 enabled。
enable 意为“使能够”，自那以后导演天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 enables。
enable 意为“使能够”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯使能够让那些孩子把书念完”，此处为不定式 to enable the boys to finish school。
enable 意为“使能够”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人使能够过，故用过去完成时 had enabled。
enable 意为“使能够”，导演说“使能够让那些孩子把书念完这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 enabling the boys to finish school 作主语。
enable 意为“使成为”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使成为使村子还得上欠账”，should ever 之后用原形 enable the village to pay its debts。
enable 意为“使成为”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使成为使村子还得上欠账（enable the village to pay its debts at once），以后再也不要提起。
enable 意为“使能够”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例使成为使村子还得上欠账，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 enables。
enable 意为“使能够”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就使能够让那些孩子把书念完，用一般过去式 enabled 叙述。
enable 意为“使能够”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要使能够让那些孩子把书念完，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 enable 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the director enabled the boys to finish school on the same day, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director enables the boys to finish school before dawn whenever the theatre asks.
Enabling the boys to finish school on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever enable the village to pay its debts before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre enables the village to pay its debts on the same day every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother enabled the boys to finish school again, and the theatre remembered that half.
